author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
description:
A quiet lake released a cloud of carbon dioxide that suffocated an entire village. No warning. No smell. No escape. What happened at Lake Nyos in 1986 and at Lake Monoun in 1984 is a rare disaster, but it could happen again.
